***[[2026 northeastern Syria offensive]]
****[[Syria]]n [[Syrian Armed Forces|government forces]] capture many towns in [[Aleppo Governorate]], including [[Dayr Hafir]] and [[Maskanah]], after [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] (SDF) units withdraw from their positions. **The [[United States Armed Forces]] formally withdraws from [[Iraq]]'s [[Al-Asad Airbase]], handing over full operational control of the airbase to the [[Iraqi Armed Forces]] for the first time since 2014. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iraq-takes-full-control-air-base-after-us-withdrawal-defence-ministry-says-2026-01-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[EU–Mercosur Association Agreement]]
**The [[European Union]] and [[Mercosur]] formally sign the [[free trade agreement]] between the two blocs after 25 years of negotiations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/eu-mercosur-sign-trade-deal-after-25-years-negotiations-2026-01-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Binaliw landslide]]
**The death toll from the [[Garbage landslide|landslide]] in the Binaliw [[landfill]] in [[Cebu City]], [[Philippines]], rises to 35. Search operations are ongoing for the last victim. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/regions/2026/1/17/binaliw-landslide-death-toll-now-at-35-1-still-missing-1550 (ABS-CBN News)]
*[[2026 Biobío wildfires]]
**At least 16 people are killed, more than 50,000 are evacuated and a [[state of emergency]] is declared due to wildfires in [[Ñuble Region]] and [[Biobío Region]], [[Chile]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260118-chile-declares-emergency-as-wildfires-kill-at-least-15 (France 24)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cz7ypw4rjrzo (BBC News)]
*[[2026 Indonesia Air Transport ATR 42 crash]]
**An [[Indonesia Air Transport]] [[ATR 42-500|ATR 42-512]] aircraft operated by the [[Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries|marine affairs ministry]] carrying eleven people loses contact in [[Maros Regency]], [[South Sulawesi]], while flying to [[Makassar]] and crashes. A search and rescue effort is underway. [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-8311723/kronologi-pesawat-atr-rute-yogya-makassar-hilang-kontak-di-maros (Detikcom <small>in Indonesian</small>)] [https://en.antaranews.com/news/400346/basarnas-confirms-11-people-aboard-missing-atr-42-500-in-sulawesi (ANTARA)]

[https://www.dawn.com/news/1967505 (''Dawn'')] [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-massive-fire-erupt-shopping-mall-karachi-29d879a1c568f7883db1c2aac1f9d8e6 (AP)]

[https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-fatal-road-crashes-bus-truck-007a13967e53d0ac48adb69f11b27504 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Beninese parliamentary election]]
**Provisional results in [[Benin]] reveal that the [[Progressive Union Renewal]] won 60 out of 109 seats in the [[National Assembly (Benin)|National Assembly]], followed by the [[Republican Bloc]] with 49 seats. Both parties in the National Assembly are part of a [[Coalition government|coalition]] supportive of [[President of Benin|President]] [[Patrice Talon]]. [https://beninwebtv.bj/en/2026-legislative-elections-in-benin-60-seats-for-the-upr-and-49-seats-for-the-br-cena/ (''Benin Web TV'')]
*[[2026 Ugandan general election]]
**[[Uganda|Ugandan]] [[President of Uganda|president]] [[Yoweri Museveni]] is re-elected to a seventh term with 71.65% of the vote, while opposition leader [[Bobi Wine]] comes second with 24.72% of the vote. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20260117-uganda-president-yoweri-museveni-wins-seventh-term-rival-bobi-wine-rejects-fake-results (France 24)]
